title: MV Queen Trader – SMS/ISPS Internal Audit & BV Annual Survey

items.title: Confirm exact audit scope (full SMS + ISPS or sampled chapters) and auditor names
Confirm BV survey scope: which certificates endorsed at this call, any class items added
Obtain previous internal audit report and last annual survey report
Confirm whether the October crew change (Master + 2) coincides with the audit port
Close out the findings from the previous internal audit
Check every statutory and class certificate: validity, last endorsement, survey window
List anything expiring before mid-2027 and flag to office
Confirm CSR, SMC, ISSC, DOC copy, MLC, IAPP supplement, EEXI/CII statement on board and current
Ship's SMS copies match latest office issue (Mar 2026 rev + all appendages)
All forms current revision; superseded pages removed
Master's review / management review record on file
CE Standing Orders signed by all engine officers and current
Familiarization checklists complete for everyone joined in last 6 months
GC QNTR-GC-033 hatch cover HP flange O-ring: status and office reply on file
SCR air compressor bearing guarantee claim: status, temporary arrangement, main air reserve mitigation documented
No.2 C/H water ingress sensor guarantee claim: submitted and acknowledged
Deck crane annual survey (due Aug 2026): confirm done, record filed
15 ppm bilge alarm / Valve X test: office confirmation, test done and recorded (ORB Code I x3, Bilge Monitor Log, photos) or documented as pending
All PSC and BV observations from New Orleans closed with evidence
Near-miss and NC reports since last audit: corrective action and closure on each
PMS overdue list at zero, or justified deferrals approved by office
Critical equipment list vs critical spares ROB cross-checked
ORB Part I reconciles with Daily Sounding Log and tank soundings
BDNs and MARPOL samples complete; sample locker location decided and labelled
SCR NOx spot-check records (Scheme A) on file; EGCS/IAPP records if applicable
Calibration records: portable gas detectors, OCM, fixed gas detection
LO, fuel and cooling water analysis reports with actions on out-of-spec results
Emergency generator: auto-start on blackout simulation and load test, logged
Emergency fire pump: pressure at furthest hydrant, logged
Emergency steering from steering flat with bridge comms, logged
Quick-closing valves and remote stops operated and reset
Fire dampers, skylights, E/R closing appliances operate freely, marked
Fixed CO2: cylinder service dates, release line, pre-discharge alarm, vent stop
Fire detection: loop/zone test with bridge and E/R panel
Bilge system: wells clean, pumps and eductor tested, OWS and 15 ppm alarm with 3-way valve
Sewage plant and incinerator operating, records current
Boiler safety valves: last float/lift date recorded, gags removed
ME and generator alarms/trips (overspeed, LO low pressure) test records
Structural fire protection: E/R doors self-closing, penetrations sealed
Watertight doors and remote valve indicators tested
LSA/FFA inventory vs SEQ record; rescue boat engine started and run
E/R bilges dry, no oil leaks under engines, purifier room clean
Escape routes clear, IMO signage and emergency lighting checked
Workshop, stores and spares racks in order and labelled
Steering gear room: hydraulic piping spray shields fitted, no loose gear
Chemical and paint stores: SDS on hand, segregation correct
E/R, steering gear, emergency generator room restricted-area signage in place
Access control: locks and key register working; gangway watch agreed for port
Security lighting and CCTV operating
SSAS test record current; DoS log, security level records, last 10 port calls up to date (SSO)
Own SSP duties known and can be stated on request
ORB, Garbage Record Book, Ballast Water Record Book
Bilge Monitor Log and OWS operation log
Rest hours: non-conformances explained and countersigned
Permits to work, enclosed-space entries, hot-work records
PMS job cards completed and closed with man-hours
Training and drill records current

phases.name: Week 3: Drills, mock audit, corrective actions

items.title: Fire drill with E/R fire scenario and CO2 release simulation
Abandon ship drill; rescue boat lowered and engine run if conditions allow
Enclosed space entry and rescue drill
Oil spill (SOPEP) drill in E/R or at bunker manifold
Emergency steering drill
Blackout and dead-ship recovery drill
Security drill: raised level, unauthorized access or bomb threat
Run SMS internal audit checklist chapter by chapter with 2/E as auditee
Interview engine ratings and junior officers: standing orders, SMS duties, near-miss reporting, DPA contact, overriding authority
"Show me" questions for permits, LOTO, enclosed space, hot work
Toolbox session on weak spots, recorded as training
Every mock-audit finding closed with photo, log entry or job card
Repair list and defect reports updated with target dates and office responses
Critical spares ROB physically verified against the list
Hydraulic/pneumatic hoses, safety valves, pressure gauges: dates and condition checked
Deferred maintenance has written office approval attached
Auditor file: certificates, previous audit report, open-items tracker, drill records, PMS summary, office correspondence
Surveyor file: certificates, previous survey report, Week 2 test records, repair list, spares list
Crew briefing: schedule, escorts, who speaks to whom
Final E/R clean-down; check for fresh leaks on audit morning
If Master changes at this port: agree who signs attendance; joining Master's handover and familiarization ready
Handover notes for any crew signing off
One engineer accompanies surveyor at all times; one officer accompanies auditor
Running list of every point raised, with owner and deadline
Evidence produced on request, from the responsible person
Closing meeting: agree wording of each finding (observation vs NC) before signing
Report filed; corrective action plan started same day
